grid=[[9,9,9,9,4,9,9,9,5],[4,9,8,9,3,9,9,9,9],[5,5,8,5,9,9,9,1,9]]
def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); out=[]
    for i in range(3*h):
        j=i if i<h else (2*h-1-i if i<2*h else 3*h-1-i)
        row=grid[h-1-j] if i<h or i>=2*h else grid[j-h]
        out.append(list(reversed(row))+list(row))
    return out
